description: List the versions under an application, with their container image, resources, ports (including whether TLS Upgrade is on, which browser/WebGL clients need for wss://) and whether a registry login is set for pulling the image. Use this to find the version name to deploy, to check a version is ready before deploying, or to copy the non-secret settings (image, resources, ports) of a working version when creating a new one. The registry login and secret env values are never readable: the API returns "This value is set and encrypted" for them, so get them from the dashboard's Container Registry page or the developer.

application.description: Application name, as returned by edgegap_list_apps.

name: edgegap_list_app_versions
title: List versions of an application
